Plugin.Name: Steward
Plugin.Overview: Runs Claude Code as an always-on service on your Unraid server, reachable from the Claude app on your phone or from claude.ai/code through Remote Control. Independent of the array and Docker: it keeps working while the array is stopped and across reboots, with the Claude Code binary cached on the boot device. Includes automatic Claude Code updates (only when no session is active), a Settings page with guided sign-in, and guardrails for a root shell: a permission policy plus a command-inspecting hook that block disk-wiping tools and secret files outright and ask before deletions, shutdowns or writes to /boot/config. Requires Unraid 7.3 or newer with Internal Boot (/boot on ZFS); USB (FAT) boot is not supported. You sign in with your own Claude subscription that includes Claude Code and Remote Control; usage is billed to your own account. The first install downloads one pinned Claude Code version straight from Anthropic's release server and installs it only if its SHA256 matches the value built into the plugin; no installer script is run. Later updates use Claude Code's own updater and are checked against the SHA256 Anthropic publishes for that version. The daily auto-update replaces the root-running binary outside the plugin file; the service keeps a remotely driven root agent running; both are by design and documented. This plugin was previously published as claude-unraid by the same author: installing it over that version migrates the data and removes the old plugin automatically.
